_meta.title: Vectorize (SVG)
_meta.description: cj_image_tools CJVectorize: traces the source image into a stacked-layer SVG (vtracer when installed and engine=vtracer, otherwise the built-in OpenCV tracer: k-means palette, per-colour contours with holes as evenodd paths, cubic smoothing). Saves CJ_Vector/vector_NNNNN_.svg plus a preview PNG rasterized back from the SVG; the preview is the job image, the SVG is listed as a downloadable file output. CPU only, no models.
